mapper.select: SELECT ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_file uf INNER JOIN file f ON f.file_id = uf.file_id WHERE uf.user_id = #{userId} AND uf.is_deleted = 0 AND COALESCE(f.status, 'READY') != 'DELETING' ) AS totalFileCount, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_file uf INNER JOIN file f ON f.file_id = uf.file_id WHERE uf.user_id = #{userId} AND uf.is_deleted = 0 AND COALESCE(f.status, 'READY') != 'DELETING' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM picture_tag pt WHERE pt.file_id = f.file_id ) ) AS untaggedFileCount, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_file uf INNER JOIN file f ON f.file_id = uf.file_id LEFT JOIN location l ON l.file_id = f.file_id WHERE uf.user_id = #{userId} AND uf.is_deleted = 0 AND COALESCE(f.status, 'READY') != 'DELETING' AND ( l.file_id IS NULL OR COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(l.full_address), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(l.district), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(l.city), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(l.province), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(l.country), '')) IS NULL ) ) AS missingLocationFileCount, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_file uf INNER JOIN file f ON f.file_id = uf.file_id WHERE uf.user_id = #{userId} AND uf.is_deleted = 0 AND f.category = 'image' AND COALESCE(f.status, 'READY') != 'DELETING' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM file_feature ff WHERE ff.user_id = #{userId} AND ff.file_id = f.file_id ) ) AS missingFeatureFileCount, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_file uf INNER JOIN file f ON f.file_id = uf.file_id WHERE uf.user_id = #{userId} AND uf.is_deleted = 0 AND f.category = 'image' AND COALESCE(f.status, 'READY') != 'DELETING' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM async_task ai WHERE ai.user_id = #{userId} AND ai.file_id = f.file_id AND ai.task_type IN ('IMAGE_TAG', 'FACE_ANALYSIS') AND ai.status = 'SUCCEEDED' ) ) AS missingAiAnalysisFileCount, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT sp.similar_id FROM similar_picture sp INNER JOIN user_file uf ON uf.file_id = sp.file_id AND uf.user_id = #{userId} AND uf.is_deleted = 0 WHERE sp.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY sp.similar_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sp.file_id) > 1 ) similar_groups ) AS similarGroupCount, ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sp.file_id) FROM similar_picture sp INNER JOIN user_file uf ON uf.file_id = sp.file_id AND uf.user_id = #{userId} AND uf.is_deleted = 0 WHERE sp.user_id = #{userId} ) AS similarFileCount, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM async_task task WHERE task.user_id = #{userId} AND task.task_type IN ('IMAGE_FEATURE', 'FACE_ANALYSIS', 'IMAGE_TAG') AND task.status IN ('FAILED', 'DEAD') ) AS failedAiTaskCount, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM async_task task WHERE task.user_id = #{userId} AND task.task_type IN ('IMAGE_FEATURE', 'FACE_ANALYSIS', 'IMAGE_TAG') AND task.status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING') AND task.update_time < #{staleBefore} ) AS staleAiTaskCount, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM async_task task WHERE task.user_id = #{userId} AND task.task_type IN ('IMAGE_FEATURE', 'FACE_ANALYSIS', 'IMAGE_TAG') AND task.status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING', 'FAILED') ) AS pendingAiTaskCount, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_file uf INNER JOIN file f ON f.file_id = uf.file_id WHERE uf.user_id = #{userId} AND uf.is_deleted = 0 AND COALESCE(f.status, 'READY') != 'DELETING' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM album_picture ap INNER JOIN album a ON a.album_id = ap.album_id WHERE ap.user_id = #{userId} AND ap.file_id = f.file_id AND a.user_id = #{userId} AND a.type = 'normal' ) ) AS unalbumedFileCount
